t: Nix Flakes and FAQuilizer: Architecting Cross-Platform Browser Automation
s: This article details FAQuilizer, a tool for stealthy, local browser automation and web scraping that captures a 'digital fossil record' for AI analysis. It emphasizes reproducible development environments using Nix Flakes to solve cross-platform challenges.

AI-driven data extraction: 'Digital fossil record' (DOM, accessibility tree, screenshots)
